SL currently surfaces $54K-$197K/yr to every new-applicant fixture that exceeds 50% FRL. R-REV-02 is the open investigation.
Revenue · LAP High Poverty (SL-only).impact_note: Universal to new-applicant fixtures — not Cedar Grove-specific.
